opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)

amount.raw: up to £500,000; in special cases, and by prior agreement, up to £750,000. Most grants awarded are below £300,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Not open to individuals without formal employment or contractual relationship with the hosting institution, projects led by schools or further education colleges, projects led by undergraduates or master's students, PhD fees, or projects led by organisations not based in the UK (exceptional overseas cases considered).
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of the Foundation's five interconnected priority questions and aim to improve lives in the UK. Two application deadlines a year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK-based organisations. Applicants from diverse backgrounds encouraged, particularly individuals and organisations from racially minoritised communities; partnership applications encouraged.
opportunities.summary: Research funding to understand the barriers and pathways to a racially just and inclusive society. 2026 priority theme: inter-generational changes, continuities and challenges in racially diverse UK. One deadline a year in Autumn.
